IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: TO SECURE A SAFE AND STABLE CLIMATE BY ACCELERATING THE GLOBAL TRANSITION TO NET-ZERO GREENHOUSE GAS EMISSIONS AND A THRIVING, JUST, AND RESILIENT ECONOMY.
IRS990.MissionDesc: THE NONPARTISAN CENTER FOR CLIMATE AND ENERGY SOLUTIONS WORKS TO SECURE A SAFE AND STABLE CLIMATE BY ACCELERATING THE GLOBAL TRANSITION TO NET-ZERO GREENHOUSE GAS EMISSIONS AND A THRIVING, JUST, AND RESILIENT ECONOMY. FOR OVER 25 YEARS, C2ES HAS FORGED INNOVATIVE SOLUTIONS TO ADDRESS CLIMATE AND ENERGY CHALLENGES. C2ES ENGAGES OUR BUSINESS COUNCIL AND OTHER BUSINESS NETWORKS TO STRENGTHEN CORPORATE CLIMATE ACTION AND MOBILIZE BUSINESS SUPPORT FOR CLIMATE POLICIES.
IRS990.Desc: US POLICY AND OUTREACH: C2ES BUILDS DURABLE, BIPARTISAN SUPPORT FOR AMBITIOUS CLIMATE AND ENERGY POLICIES, ENGAGING LEADING COMPANIES ACROSS THE U.S. ECONOMY TO EDUCATE POLICYMAKERS ON ISSUES INCLUDING FEDERAL PERMITTING REFORM, CLEAN ENERGY TAX CREDITS, AND CLIMATE-ALIGNED TRADE POLICIES. OUR RECOMMENDATIONS STRENGTHENED THE ENVIRONMENTAL INTEGRITY AND EMISSIONS REDUCTION POTENTIAL OF CLEAN ELECTRICITY TAX CREDITS UNDER THE INFLATION REDUCTION ACT. WE CONVENED 130 COMPANIES IN OUR TECHNOLOGY WORKING GROUPS, LEADING TO 4 POLICY BRIEFS AND 18 POLICY RECOMMENDATIONS TO SUPPORT CLEAN TECHNOLOGY INNOVATION. A C2ES REGIONAL ROUNDTABLE IN VIRGINIA, ONE OF 4 DURING THE YEAR, INSPIRED THE INTRODUCTION OF LEGISLATION TO MORE THAN TRIPLE THE AMOUNT OF LDES CAPACITY UTILITIES ARE REQUIRED TO SUPPLY.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT AND RESILIENCE: C2ES LED NEW RESEARCH ON EXISTING GUIDANCE AND THE VIEWS OF REGULATORS AND NGOS ON CREDIBLE TRANSITION PLANS, INCLUDING DEVELOPING A TRANSITION PLAN INDEX THAT DISTILLS BEST PRACTICES TO HELP COMPANIES CREATE, IMPLEMENT AND DISCLOSE ROBUST NET-ZERO TRANSITION PLANS ALIGNED WITH THE PARIS AGREEMENT. C2ES CONVENES BUSINESSES AND OTHER STAKEHOLDERS TO HELP COMMUNITIES ADAPT TO CLIMATE CHANGE THROUGH OUR CLIMATE RESILIENT COMMUNITIES ACCELERATOR. WE COMPLETED A SUCCESSFUL PILOT IN COLORADO IDENTIFYING HOW TO BUILD RESILIENCE TO WILDFIRES AND HEAT. THROUGH OUR CORPORATE CLIMATE RESILIENCE PATHWAYS INITIATIVE, WE HELPED STAND UP A COMMUNITY OF PRACTICE THAT WILL HELP COMPANIES ADVANCE CLIMATE RESILIENCE AND ADAPTATION ACROSS THEIR OPERATIONS, VALUE CHAINS, AND COMMUNITIES.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: INTERNATIONAL AND CARBON MARKETS: C2ES SUPPORTS THE ENVIRONMENTAL EFFECTIVENESS AND SUCCESSFUL IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PARIS AGREEMENT, INCLUDING CONVENING REGULAR MEETINGS OF SENIOR CLIMATE NEGOTIATORS TO PROVIDE EXPERT ANALYSIS AND A TRUSTED FORUM FOR DISCUSSION. AT COP29 WE SUPPORTED THE PARTIES IN ADOPTING A NEW CLIMATE FINANCE GOAL, INCLUDING DEVELOPED COUNTRIES PLEDGES TO MOBILIZE AT LEAST $300 BILLION PER YEAR BY 2035 FOR CLIMATE ACTION IN DEVELOPING COUNTRIES AND THE LAUNCH OF AN EFFORT TO SCALE UP PUBLIC AND PRIVATE CLIMATE FINANCE TO $1.3 TRILLION. GUIDANCE NEEDED TO OPERATIONALIZE CARBON MARKETS UNDER ARTICLE 6 OF THE PARIS AGREEMENT WAS ALSO FINALIZED. C2ES ALSO SERVED AS SECRETARIAT OF THE ENERGY TRANSITION ACCELERATOR (ETA), AN EFFORT TO CATALYZE CARBON FINANCE TO SPEED THE JUST CLEAN ENERGY TRANSITION IN EMERGING AND DEVELOPING ECONOMIES.
